title: Social media
slide_intent: Identify official channels clearly because people need to know who is speaking before trusting a post.
strategic_value: Consistent names, descriptions and profile images can make Helsinki’s social accounts easier to recognize.
demonstration: This webpage introduction identifies account name, about information and profile image as signals of an official city channel.
practical_value: Audit the account-level identifiers before refining individual posts.
